[H2] Frequently asked questions
Can I cancel the Play Pass and get a refund? Yes, you can, if it is your first purchase of any Play Pass and you purchased it directly from Nex. Within 14 days of activation of such Play Pass, you can cancel it and get a full refund by contacting customer support. After 14 days, there will be no refund after cancellation and your access to the full catalog will end on the original renewal date.
Play Pass purchased from Amazon or retailers are not refundable due to their own policies.
Can I buy Play Pass as a gift? Yes. Buy a pass and share the activation code, or print a gift card.
Check out How to Set Up Nex Playground for Gift-Giving Success.
What is the difference between this Play Pass and the Play Pass sold elsewhere? Play Passes purchased directly from Nex are fully refundable within 14 days of activation (conditions apply). Purchases made through Amazon and retailers are not eligible for a refund due to their policies.
How long does it take to get my Play Pass activation code? Code delivery typically takes 30 minutes or less after purchase on Nex Playground website, see this help article if you have not received your activation code after 60 minutes.
Play Pass purchased from Amazon may take up to 48 hours to deliver a code.
If you already have Nex Playground unboxed, buying Play Pass directly on your Nex Playground by scanning the on-screen QR code will give you instant access, without needing an activation code.
Do I need multiple Play Passes if I have more than one Nex Playground? Play Pass can be used on a maximum of 2 Nex Playgrounds via the same Nex account if they belong to the same household. See help article here for details.
What is Play Pass? Play Pass is the game subscription for Nex Playground. It unlocks 60+ active games, including Bluey, Barbie, NFL FLAG, Sesame Street and PAC-MAN, and adds new games and updates every month. There are no ads or in-app purchases.
Do I need Play Pass to use Nex Playground? No. Every Nex Playground includes the Starter Pack: Fruit Ninja, Starri, Party Fowl, Whack-a-Mole Deluxe and Go Keeper, free forever. Play Pass unlocks the rest of the library.
How much does Play Pass cost? $89 for 12 months (about $7 a month) or $49 for 3 months. One pass covers up to 2 Nex Playground consoles in your home.
Can I buy games individually? No. Nex doesn't sell individual games, ads or in-app purchases. One Play Pass unlocks everything, so kids are never asked to buy more.

Children’s Privacy
We are committed to protecting the privacy of children. The following provisions apply specifically to Nex Playground and any other child-directed portions of our Services. We comply with the Children’s Online Privacy Protection Act (“COPPA”) and applicable regulations, including 16 C.F.R. Part 312.
Age Rules and Parental Consent
Nex Playground is designed for family use. For COPPA compliance, users under 13 in the United States require verifiable parental consent before we collect personal information beyond what is permitted under the internal operations exception. For EU and UK users:
Our platform requires parental account set-up and consent before a child’s account is activated. If we discover that a child’s data has been collected without appropriate consent, we will delete it promptly.
Parental Consent
We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under the age of 13 on child-directed portions of our Services without a lawful basis under applicable law. On Nex Playground, a limited set of technical data (device identifier and device vitals) is collected from first boot solely under the COPPA internal operations exception (16 C.F.R. §312.5(c)(7)) and, for EU users, under a documented Legitimate Interests basis (GDPR Art. 6(1)(f)). Following device setup and account sign-in, we present a data collection consent prompt. (For more information, please see Persistent Identifier – Internal Operations Exception below). Where a parent or user consents, analytics collection continues under GDPR Art. 6(1)(a). Where consent is declined, no further analytics events are transmitted and any pre-consent data associated with that device is deleted. Parents or guardians may review the personal information collected from their child, request deletion of that information, and withdraw consent at any time by contacting us at support@nex.inc.
How Consent Works and How to Withdraw
Consent is recorded with a timestamp, the version of the consent prompt shown, and the parental account ID. To withdraw consent at any time, parents may contact support@nex.inc. Withdrawal does not affect the lawfulness of processing carried out before withdrawal. Upon withdrawal, analytics collection will cease and any pre-consent data associated with that device will be deleted.
Information We Do Not Collect from Children
Even though Nex Playground is equipped with a camera, it is used solely for local motion-capture games. No images or video of any user’s interaction with Nex Playground, regardless of age, are uploaded to the cloud or otherwise collected by us via Nex Playground. We do not collect names or contact information on Nex Playground. No information from Nex Playground that could be used to directly identify a child is shared with independent third parties for commercial or advertising purposes.
Persistent Identifiers — Internal Operations Exception
On Nex Playground, we collect certain persistent identifiers and technical telemetry data from first boot to support internal operations of the Services. Specifically: (a) a persistent device identifier is transmitted to Mixpanel for internal analytics and product support, as permitted under COPPA (16 C.F.R. §312.5(c)(7)); and (b) device vitals and firmware error telemetry are transmitted to Memfault for device stability and crash diagnostics, as permitted under COPPA and, for EU users, under GDPR Art. 6(1)(f) Legitimate Interests documented in our Legitimate Interests Assessment (LIA). “Internal operations” means activities necessary to maintain or analyze the functioning of the Services, perform network communications, authenticate users or devices, ensure legal or industry compliance, and fulfil a request made by a child that is consistent with our parental consent obligations. Following sign-in, users are presented with a data collection consent prompt; where consent is given, analytics collection continues under GDPR Art. 6(1)(a); where consent is declined, pre-consent analytics data is deleted. We maintain Legitimate Interests Assessments for our pre-consent processing activities on Nex Playground, which are available upon request by contacting us at support@nex.inc.

To exercise any of these rights, please contact us at support@nex.inc. If you believe that personal information has been collected from your child without proper consent, please contact us immediately so that we may take corrective action.

We do not permit third-party operators to collect personal information from children on child-directed portions of our Services through integrated plug-ins, APIs, or SDKs for their own purposes. Any third-party service providers that access data on the child-directed portions of our Services are contractually restricted to processing that data only to provide services to us, are prohibited from using children’s data for independent commercial purposes, and are required to maintain confidentiality and appropriate security safeguards consistent with COPPA.
We use certain physical, managerial, and technical safeguards that are designed to improve the integrity and security of information that we collect and maintain, including encryption in transit (TLS) and at rest, access controls restricting data access to personnel with a legitimate operational need, Data Processing Agreements with all third-party processors, and regular security assessments. Please be aware that no security measures are perfect or impenetrable. We cannot and do not guarantee that information about you will not be accessed, viewed, disclosed, altered, or destroyed by breach of any of our physical, technical, or managerial safeguards.
Data Breach Notification
In the event of a personal data breach that is likely to result in a risk to your rights and freedoms, we will notify the relevant supervisory authority (ICO / EU DPA) within 72 hours of becoming aware, as required by GDPR Art. 33. Where the breach is likely to result in a high risk to you, we will also notify you directly without undue delay (GDPR Art. 34). To report a security concern or potential breach, please contact: security@nex.inc.
